description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Outbound Delivery provides a way to interact with the [Outbound Delivery (A2X) API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV_0002/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete outbound deliveries with their items, partners, addresses, texts and document flow, to manage handling units and serial numbers, and to pick items and post or reverse the goods issue.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete outbound deliveries, their items and their texts
Maintain delivery addresses, handling units and serial numbers
Pick one or all items, split batches, and post or reverse the goods issue
